speaker: margery_pell
text: Thin, as I said before the flag. Apprentices with nothing to do, and not a stair full of them. I am not giving you a sum. Thin is the report.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, the flag was up. Item, Augustine and Thomas came by boat, and not by the Bridge. Item, the yard was what she said it would be.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: We came by water. The Bridge was none of our road today. The house was thin, and it was quiet enough to finish a tune in, which I will take.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: John's message was at the house before we ate. Boat, not the Bridge. We did not have to guess it at the stair.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I can speak it. I ask whether anyone was listening. A few were. They were apprentices. They were not a riot. The Shrew did not ask them to become one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I came by the fields, not by the gate. Before that, two hundred yards to Leadenhall. The butter was cried at fourpence, and nobody argued with the bill.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Fourpence is your market, Will. I have no figure for this afternoon that I am willing to say, and I will not borrow one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then say none. We played. An old comedy. No crowd in it, and no crown. The bill was the Shrew, and the Shrew is what the flag was for.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The stair never thickened. I said so at morning, and the morning was right. That is the best use of me today.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The songs sat where they sit. Nobody asked them to be louder. A thin house lets a line finish. I am content with the afternoon, and I am not dressing it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I came by boat. I played. I am going back by boat. If you need a number from me, you need a different man. Supper is the only figure I am counting.

speaker: john_heminges
text: On Thursday the aldermen were already blaming stage-plays drawing prentices together. We played today. Had we shut, the Mayor would have had his sentence written for him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has not got it. We did not fear the yard. The yard was thin, and the play had nothing in it for a cry to hang on.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then write thin, and leave my box out of the proverb. I emptied it. I am not in the mood for a motto.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Augustine is content. Do not add a fear to a day that played out. The boat was a boat. I have nothing further, John.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Thomas is content if the telling stays this short. The Shrew, a boat, and no Bridge. I can remember that without a clerk.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Two by water. One by the fields. The flag up. The comedy played. That is the reckoning I will keep.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The loaf at home is a thumb short of the notch. I have written the butter beside it. Threepence, fourpence, fivepence. I am not mixing that page with the house.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Good. Keep the market in the market. My stair is not a butter stall, and I will not have it become one in the telling.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then we are done, if John is done. I will see the boat, and I will not make a procession of the way home.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I am done. The flag was ordinary. Let the telling stay ordinary. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ordinary is the word. We came as we said we would. We played the Shrew. We go home.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Home, then. And no one is to give me the City on the way to the stair. I have had the City, at second hand, all week.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The gate was not your door today. I saw you come by the field side. That was the right door.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, nothing further. Go home before someone improves the afternoon.
